milestones.name: Acquire Mantis Claw
milestones.note: Required to access the Mask Shard in the east part of Queen's Station and to keep Zote alive in Greenpath

milestones.name: Save Zote in Greenpath
milestones.note: Knight chooses to save Zote from the Vengefly King; if not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw, Zote dies

milestones.name: Save Zote in Deepnest
milestones.note: Knight chooses to save Zote from spider webs; leaving him here does not result in his death

milestones.name: Defeat Zote at Colosseum of Fools
milestones.note: Zote is the final boss of the first trial; grants Rivalry achievement

milestones.name: Collect Mask Shard at Queen's Station
milestones.note: Located in the east part of Queen's Station; requires Mantis Claw

milestones.name: Obtain Love Key
milestones.note: Found in Queen's Gardens; opens the door inside the Tower of Love

milestones.name: First arrival from Fog Canyon at Queen's Station
milestones.note: Quirrel can be encountered in the main hub of Queen's Station upon first arrival from Fog Canyon

zones.name: Fungal Wastes
zones.fingerprintHint: Fungal environment; contains Stagway tunnels, Queen's Station, Willoh NPC

zones.name: Queen's Station
zones.fingerprintHint: Main hub in Fungal Wastes; Stagway station; contains Mask Shard in east part; Quirrel and Willoh found here

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote held by Vengefly King; path leading to Greenpath from early game

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Surface town; Zote appears here after being saved in Greenpath

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found in a corridor leading to its storerooms

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found stuck in spider webs, captured by beasts

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found in resting area; final boss of first trial

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.fingerprintHint: Source location of the Love Key

zones.name: Tower of Love
zones.fingerprintHint: Door unlocked by Love Key; The Collector boss fight inside

zones.name: Fog Canyon
zones.fingerprintHint: Adjacent to Queen's Station; Quirrel arrives from here

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.grants: Access to east Queen's Station Mask Shard; deadline for saving Zote in Greenpath

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.grants: Unlocks door of Tower of Love
abilities.note: Covered in padding, bears a symbol of love; opens door where The Collector can be fought

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles; Knight can choose to save or leave Zote

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of first trial; deals no damage due to shellwood nail; defeating him grants Rivalry achievement

bosses.name: The Collector
bosses.note: Fought inside the Tower of Love after unlocking the door with the Love Key
